name: Diagnosing and Replacing Fuses
summary:
Diagnosing and Replacing Fuses is an immersive VR training application designed exclusively for learners enrolled in the Immerse Learn Diagnosing and Replacing Fuses Micro-Credential Program.

This hands-on simulation enables learners to develop practical skills in identifying electrical fuse failures, diagnosing circuit-related issues, following proper safety procedures, and performing fuse replacement in a realistic virtual environment. The training experience is built to replicate real-world troubleshoot
